description: Reads a public X (Twitter) post and returns it as Markdown: author, date, engagement, text, images, video links, polls, quoted post, and the FULL body of X Articles (long-form posts). Use it whenever the user shares an x.com or twitter.com status link. Does not return replies or full multi-post threads.

url.description: Post URL like https://x.com/user/status/123... (twitter.com, fxtwitter.com etc. also work) or a bare numeric post ID.

name: read_x_post
title: Read X post or article
